rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Security scanner and runtime protection suite for Model Context Protocol servers. Performs automated vulnerability scanning across npm and PyPI packages, detects prompt injection attempts and tool poisoning attacks, and provides real-time monitoring with risk scoring. Can be used standalone or as an MCP server itself to provide security analysis tools to AI assistants.
